entries.10cfff3fddda84f0: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells automotive parts in the United States and Mexico. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥77,591 million. Sales including inter-segment internal sales were ¥77,657 million (up 0.3% year on year), and operating profit was ¥4,402 million (down 38.5%). The securities report attributes the increase in sales to an increase in sales volume, and the decrease in operating profit to an increase in various expenses. In Mexico, because changes in the business environment meant the profit originally expected could no longer be anticipated, the carrying amounts of fixed assets such as automotive parts manufacturing equipment were reduced to their recoverable amounts, and an impairment loss of ¥1,805 million was recorded as an extraordinary loss. Franklin Precision Industry, Inc., a consolidated subsidiary in this segment, accounted for more than 10% of consolidated sales, with sales of ¥34,211 million (excluding inter-segment sales).

entries.52f51a2f72def1d4: A reportable segment based in the Czech Republic, France and Belgium. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥16,251 million. Sales including inter-segment internal sales were ¥16,288 million (up 1.9% year on year), and operating profit was ¥1,180 million (down 8.4%). The securities report attributes the increase in sales to the effect of exchange rates, and the decrease in operating profit to an increase in various expenses. Manufacturing and sales are carried out by Aisan Industry Czech s.r.o. in the Czech Republic, and Aisan Corporation Europe S.A. in Belgium is the base for sales activities in Europe. Aisan Industry France S.A.S., formerly a consolidated subsidiary, had all its shares transferred as of September 30, 2025, and was removed from the scope of consolidation.
entries.63b9b2c4820c2e17: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells automotive parts in South Korea, China, Indonesia, Thailand and India, and the one with the largest sales to external customers among the 4 reportable segments. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥135,780 million. Sales including inter-segment internal sales were ¥136,979 million (down 5.8% year on year), and operating profit was ¥9,366 million (up 20.0%). The securities report attributes the decrease in sales to a decrease in sales volume and the effect of exchange rates, and the increase in operating profit to improved profitability. In its description of business, the securities report lists as the main affiliated companies in this region Hyundam Industrial Co., Ltd. in South Korea, AISAN INDUSTRY (TIANJIN) AUTO PARTS CO., LTD. and AISAN INDUSTRY (FOSHAN) AUTO PARTS CO., LTD. in China, PT. Aisan Nasmoco Industri in Indonesia, and Aisan Industry India Pvt. Ltd. in India, among others. Note that in sales to external customers this segment is larger than Japan, while in sales including inter-segment internal sales Japan is larger.

entries.7e9e9864c206c6dd: A reportable segment in which the Company mainly manufactures and sells automotive parts in Japan. In addition to automotive parts, this segment also conducts automobile transport brokerage, civil engineering and construction, and the development and sale of computer systems and programs. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥101,210 million. Sales including inter-segment internal sales were ¥139,595 million (up 4.5% year on year), and operating profit was ¥3,160 million (up 36.3%). The securities report attributes the increase in sales to an increase in sales volume, and the increase in operating profit to improved profitability. The main affiliated companies in Japan are Teikei Carburetor Co., Ltd., Nichialloy Co., Ltd., Aisan Kumamoto Co., Ltd. (automotive parts), Aikyo Sangyo Co., Ltd. (transportation, etc.) and Aisan Computer Service Co., Ltd. (system development and calculation services). In September 2022, the Company took over the fuel pump module business from DENSO Corporation; the securities report states that the change to the Company's brand has been completed and that, from fiscal 2024, production that had been outsourced is being switched in stages to the Company's own production.
